description:
OSGi bundle and content package that forwards analytics events from AEM
        to the SharadTech st-ck-server Infralytiqs ClickHouse ingestion API,
        optionally including authentication-tracking via a Sling request filter.
        Components activate only when their OSGi configurations are deployed.
        Logging uses the com.adobexp.log facade shipped with aem-loki-integrator.core.
